## Project title

Collins College Student Engagement, Enrollment, and Retention Analysis

## Data and source

I plan to use de-identified Collins College data. I will not post student-level data or results that should not be public.

## Managerial problem

Collins College needs a clearer view of student engagement patterns and how they may relate to enrollment and retention.

## Target audience

Collins College administrators and the CEP team.

## Research questions

- What engagement information is available?
- How should enrollment and retention be defined?
- How do engagement patterns vary over time or across the student groups available for the project?
- Which patterns would be useful for future student-support decisions?

## Expected impact

I expect the project to give Collins College a clearer summary of engagement patterns and identify questions for additional study.

## Planned methods

Data cleaning, descriptive statistics, trend analysis, group comparisons, and clear data visualizations. Any final report will describe patterns carefully and will not treat an association as proof of causation.
